deep_dive.title: OPD-V: Visual On-Policy Self-Distillation with Modality Balance
deep_dive.abstract: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) has become a standard post-training approach for improving visual reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing methods draw privileged information from diverse input sources to guide self-distillation. Yet these designs overlook Modality Imbalance, a challenge inherent to MLLM reasoning. When textual information dominates generation, the model cannot fully integrate its multimodal input. Consequently, carefully designed privileged information remains underused, limiting the effectiveness of OPSD. To examine this limitation, we construct a Positive Teacher with the Zoom-In Image and a Negative Teacher with the Mask Image, which exhibit different degrees of Modality Imbalance. Changes in their reasoning correctness and token logits reveal that Modality Balance can itself serve as privileged information. Motivated by this finding, we introduce OPD-V, a visual OPSD paradigm that instantiates such information through the Positive Teacher and Negative Teacher. Positive Modality-Balance Logits Margins define a Modality-Balance Trust Region that selects the on-policy tokens used for self-distillation. Experiments across 6 benchmarks, 4 MLLM backbones, and 5 post-training methods show that OPD-V consistently improves reasoning performance while reducing training cost.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: OPD-V addresses modality imbalance in visual on-policy self-distillation for MLLMs by introducing positive and negative teachers, improving multimodal reasoning.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 现有视觉多模态大模型的后训练常采用在线策略自蒸馏，但存在模态不平衡问题，即文本信息主导生成，导致图像特权信息未被充分利用。OPD-V通过构造缩放图像的正教师和掩码图像的负教师来显式建模模态不平衡，并据此平衡自蒸馏信号。实验表明该方法能更充分地利用多模态输入，提升视觉推理性能。该工作为面向多模态模型的在线策略自蒸馏提供了新的改进方向。

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: Points out modality imbalance in visual on-policy self-distillation for MLLMs where text-dominated generation prevents use of privileged visual information, and proposes OPD-V with positive and negative teachers to balance modality influence, improving downstream visual reasoning.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 论文指出多模态LLM后训练中的OPSD方法忽视了模态不平衡问题——文本信息主导生成时会抑制多模态输入整合，导致特权信息未被充分利用。为此构建正负教师（放大/遮蔽图像）观察不同模态失衡程度，并提出OPD-V进行模态平衡的蒸馏。实验显示该方法改善了多模态推理中视觉信息的利用，提升了OPSD在MLLM后训练中的效果。
